result:
**Verdict: REVISE, one targeted fix.** After reviewing all ten screenshots, the only real defect is the Preview pill on mobile. Everything else I accept as rendered. I ran no browser or tests; Hermes needs to rerender on Thales.

**Change made** (`web/demo/preview-controls.css`, one media block added at the end)
- **What's wrong:** on a phone-sized screen (no status bar), the pill sits under the host's STAGING badge at top centre. The gap above the windows there is only about 10px.
- **The fix:** only when the status bar is absent, the pill moves to the left end of that gap (`left:14px; top:var(--safe-t)`, no centring) and is 13px tall with 8.5px text. Its wider touch area extends sideways only, never down.
- **Clearance:** it overlaps at most about 3px of the window's top border. It stays clear of the app icon, title text, the title-bar buttons and the orb.
- **The sheet** opens down from the pill, `width:min(340px, 100vw − 28px)`, so it stays on screen. The 44px controls are unchanged. The pill is still hidden in full screen and in the desk overview, and the desktop placement is unchanged.
- **For the parent:** show the staging badge only once, at the top level. The copy inside each iframe crowds the top of every app, including the Wisdom reader's ‹ / A− row. I did not change any server or parent files.

**Accepted, unchanged**
- **Wisdom opener:** the blank dark plate is what the source does when an entry has no art (`wb-noart` in shipped `wisdom.js`/`wisdom.css`). Marcus has no supplied portrait, and the six JPGs are already attached only to their own samples, so I added nothing. The serif stack and layout are identical across Nebula, Paper and Original. I kept "Begin the morning" as the entry because the Back smoke depends on it.
- **Paper reader:** the reader body already uses `--wz-reader-surface` (`wisdom.css:25`), which `theme-host.js` sets to cream for light skins. Only the cover stays dark, as shipped; flipping it just for no-art entries would break palette-only parity with Original. No Paper screenshot of a text page exists yet, so that still needs capturing.
- **Source parity:** Music, Signal and Topics each keep their own source anatomy in the screenshots, with no four-card sameness. I did not use the Signal baseline (a loading state) as proof.
- **Bridge, Back, architecture:** these match the parent's smoke run. Item 6 in my notes ("architecture.html may be missing") is out of date; I've said so in the review rather than editing the notes.

The review, with remaining issues (small pill touch target, the in-iframe staging badge, the missing Paper text-page shot, Back with the sheet open), is at `docs/evidence/opus-round2-review.md`.
